content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working with a [article_no] device running firmware [version_no] and programming it using [product_name] [version_no]. I created a User Defined Function (UDF), but received a message stating that it is not compatible with my current module. Is it possible to resolve this by only updating the firmware, or are there other solutions? If so, which firmware update should I apply? Best regards, [user_name]
Which hardware version did you use when creating the UDF? Try converting it to an older version and see if that works.
Thank you, I wasn't aware the solution could be that straightforward.

analysis.insight_summary: The user experienced an incompatibility issue when using a User Defined Function (UDF) created in [product_name] with their hardware module due to a mismatch between firmware and software versions. The resolution involves converting the UDF to a compatible or older format, emphasizing the need for clearer guidance on how to address version conflicts and navigate compatibility between firmware and software.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that UDFs made in [product_name] will work seamlessly with their hardware module, or expects detailed instructions on resolving compatibility issues, such as through firmware updates or version conversions.
